hints.title: Alternating Diagonal Scan Obstacle
hints.text: Traversing an M x N grid along anti-diagonals requires flipping direction on every tier to avoid boundary wall collisions. How can grouping by coordinate sum r + c simplify the zigzag order?

hints.title: Constant Coordinate Sum Invariant
hints.text: All elements on the same diagonal share the identical sum d = r + c. For even d, elements progress upward-right; for odd d, elements progress downward-left.

hints.title: Sum Index Iteration Procedure
hints.text: Collect all elements into buckets by diagonal index d = r + c from 0 to m + n - 2. For each d, if d is even, append bucket elements reversed; if d is odd, append bucket elements in natural order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every cell is inserted once and copied to the output list in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating boundary bounce checks with while loops involves complex corner-case logic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bucket array of length M + N - 1 uses O(M * N) intermediate space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using diagonal property r + c to simplify alternating traversal direction.
